payload.text: The next release's work comes to vc as plans in words, and nothing builds until vc's go: ISSUE:0010 (low, six nits; cc, with ic signing any interface text); ic's todo 5 (install says what it waits for while herdr-app check runs, and bounds the wait); ic's todo 6 (nits on cc's landed user-facing text, riding ISSUE:0010). ic's todo 7 (ways into the mod from inside Herdr, now that ccusage herdr launch exists) goes to hv through vc. When the next release is cut is hv's word: one cut with everything ready, never small ones.
